subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should ambiguous owner-qualified skills wait for an owner-aware ClawHub bulk contract, or may OpenClaw fall back to single-skill verification when bulk resolution fails?
rationale: The existing integration intentionally avoids per-skill fallback requests, while the deployed and documented bulk contract does not establish support for `ownerHandle`; choosing the permanent cross-repository behavior requires owner intent.

options.title: Ship owner-aware bulk support first
options.body: Update and deploy the ClawHub bulk endpoint to accept and resolve `ownerHandle`, then merge this client change with live gateway proof.

options.title: Approve a bounded fallback
options.body: Let OpenClaw call owner-qualified single verification only for ambiguous or not-found bulk results, with request-cap and compatibility tests.

options.title: Pause the OpenClaw patch
options.body: Keep this PR unmerged until the external contract has an identified implementation and deployment path.

recommendation.title: Ship owner-aware bulk support first
recommendation.body: Update and deploy the ClawHub bulk endpoint to accept and resolve `ownerHandle`, then merge this client change with live gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current bulk-verdict integration and documented the intentional no-fallback boundary.
